name: test_01_setup_cache
root_cause: Pollutes shared state depended on by downstream test(s)

findings.prescription: Use monkeypatch.setitem() to avoid mutating shared module-level state across tests.
Use monkeypatch.setenv() or monkeypatch.setitem() to avoid leaking environment changes to other tests.

name: test_02_order_dependent_consumer
root_cause: Passes only when preceded by test_01_setup_cache; relies on shared state set by that test

findings.prescription: Use monkeypatch.setitem() to avoid mutating shared module-level state across tests.
Use monkeypatch.setenv() or monkeypatch.setitem() to avoid leaking environment changes to other tests.

name: test_03_unseeded_ml_threshold
root_cause: Non-deterministic randomness: different seeds flip pass/fail

findings.prescription: Add random.seed(42) or np.random.default_rng(42) before sampling; increase sample size or use a tolerance-based assertion.

name: test_04_async_race_condition
root_cause: Timing-sensitive: thread scheduling variability flips pass/fail

findings.prescription: Replace time.sleep with thread.join(timeout=2.0) or threading.Event.wait().
Replace time.sleep with thread.join(timeout=2.0) or threading.Event.wait().

name: test_05_broken_build_control
root_cause: Test fails unconditionally in all execution modes
